31:     def names(self, fixture):

123:     def test_foreign_unissued_direct_and_reentrant_entries_refuse_before_create(self):
124:         for fault in ("foreign_profile", "unissued_copy", "subclass", "wrong_permit",
125:                       "direct_kernel", "closed_real_entry"):
126:             with self.subTest(fault=fault):
127:                 f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
128:                 with self.assertRaises(REFUSALS) as caught:
129:                     with f:
130:                         with f.scope() as startup:
131:                             profile, permit = startup, startup.permit
132:                             if fault == "foreign_profile":
133:                                 profile = {"controller": True}
134:                             elif fault == "unissued_copy":
135:                                 profile = replace(startup)
136:                             elif fault == "subclass":
137:                                 class OtherController(adapter._ControllerASRStart):
138:                                     pass
139:                                 profile = OtherController(**startup.__dict__)
140:                             elif fault == "wrong_permit":
141:                                 permit = replace(permit, identity=object())
142:                             elif fault == "direct_kernel":
143:                                 f.manager._kernel.start_owned_worker(f.record.protection, permit.identity, startup)
144:                                 self.fail("Direct kernel entry unexpectedly returned")
145:                             elif fault == "closed_real_entry":
146:                                 adapter._fixed_real_worker_start(startup, permit, None)
147:                                 self.fail("Real worker entry unexpectedly returned")
148:                             f.factory.open_owned_session(profile, permit)
149:                 self.assertEqual(f.trace, [])
150:                 self.assertIsNone(f.record.owner)
151:                 self.assertEqual(f.manager._kernel._factory_starts, {})
152:                 self.assertEqual(f.factory._start_attempts, {})
153:                 if fault == "closed_real_entry":
154:                     self.assertIn("child transport", str(caught.exception))
155:                 self.assertIsNone(resolver.REAL_APPROVAL)
156:         f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
157:         refusals = []
158:         def reenter(fixture, startup):
159:             with self.assertRaises(LifecycleUnavailable) as caught:
160:                 fixture.manager._kernel.start_owned_worker(
161:                     fixture.record.protection, startup.permit.identity, startup)
162:             refusals.append(caught.exception)
163:         f.before_create = reenter

165:             with f.published():
166:                 self.assertEqual(len(refusals), 1)
167:                 self.assertEqual(f.f.events.count("create"), 1)
168:                 self.assertEqual(self.names(f).count("create_enter"), 1)

170:     def mutate_relation(self, f, fault):
171:         if fault == "selection":
172:             adapter.RUNTIME_PROFILE = replace(f.profile, profile_id="changed-generated-profile")
173:         elif fault == "retained_worker":
174:             f.manager._kernel._starts[f.startup.permit.identity] = object()
175:         elif fault == "token_worker":
176:             f.token.worker = object()
177:         elif fault == "record_owner":
178:             f.record.owner = object()
179:         else:
180:             raise AssertionError("Unknown fixed relation fault")

182:     def test_post_bind_identity_mutation_reaches_new_pre_resume_boundary(self):
183:         for fault in ("selection", "retained_worker", "token_worker", "record_owner"):
184:             with self.subTest(fault=fault):
185:                 f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
186:                 f.after_bind = lambda fixture, worker: self.mutate_relation(fixture, fault)
187:                 original = self.fail_start(f)
188:                 self.assert_retained(f)
189:                 self.assertIn("bind_return", self.names(f))
190:                 self.assertNotIn("resume_enter", self.names(f))
191:                 self.assertFalse(f.token.resume_attempted)
192:                 self.assertIs(f.custody.primary_error, original)
193:                 self.assertEqual(len(f.stop_workers), 0 if fault == "retained_worker" else 1)
194:                 if fault == "retained_worker":
195:                     self.assertIs(f.token.worker, f.returned_worker)
196:                     self.assertIn("Exact worker stop raised: LifecycleUnavailable", original.__notes__)
197:                 else:
198:                     self.assertIs(f.manager._kernel._starts[f.startup.permit.identity], f.returned_worker)
199:                     self.assertIs(f.stop_workers[0], f.returned_worker)
